title: Act: Apply Tailwind desktop layout classes and overflow rules
summary: Rewrite GameLayout root/main/aside classes and add html/body/#root overflow rules
description: Replace the legacy class names on GameLayout's root, main and aside with Tailwind utilities for the 80/20 split and independent story scrolling, and add the overflow rules for html, body and #root to styles.css.
acceptance_criteria: GameLayout root has grid h-screen w-full overflow-hidden grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr].
The aside has overflow-y-auto and md:h-screen; the main has min-w-0.
styles.css sets html, body and #root to height 100% and overflow hidden.

steps.action: Replace className 'game-layout' on the root div with the Tailwind string, 'scene-area' on main with 'relative min-w-0 overflow-hidden', and add 'overflow-y-auto md:h-screen' to the aside classes.
steps.code:
<div className="grid h-screen w-full grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr]">
<main className="relative min-w-0 overflow-hidden">
steps.expected: Root div has grid, h-screen, overflow-hidden and md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr]; main has min-w-0.

steps.action: Add a rule giving html, body and #root height 100% and overflow hidden to prevent page scroll.
steps.expected: Stylesheet contains the html, body, #root rule.
